title: Talking Movies with a Hollywood Star
shared_passage: Watch an interview with an actor about his latest film. For questions 1 to 7, choose the best answer (A, B, or C).

questions.question: What do they say about the movie?
options: The movie has been in cinemas for one week.
It has earned 100 million dollars in the US.
Jake was sure it would be a success.

questions.question: What does Jake say about the locations?
options: The movie was shot in two main locations.
Some of the locations were dangerous.
It was tough to shoot in some of the locations.

questions.question: What does Jake say about his character?
options: It's the most different character he's ever played.
He worked with the director to learn combat techniques.
The script helped him get into the role.

questions.question: What do they say about the cast?
options: None of them were big stars, but they were all very talented.
Some actors gave better performances than others.
Some celebrities make brief appearances in the film.

questions.question: What does Jake say about the special effects?
options: It wasn't easy to interact with things that weren't there.
They used AI to create the visuals.
The special effects were used to show his character's imagination.

questions.question: What do they say about the critics?
options: Most reviews say it's a must-see film.
The film has received mixed reviews.
Jake doesn't agree with some of the reviews.

questions.question: Will there be a second part of this movie?
options: Most likely, yes.
Probably not.
It depends.
